notes: Scripts run in the XScript app (Chaquopy Python 3.10, numpy, opencv, pillow, requests, pyyaml, packaging). Extra PyPI packages install at runtime: list them in the project's requirements.txt, or use pip_install / xscript.android.pip.
Two API families: xscript.android.* (native) and ascript.android.* (drop-in for AScript scripts; `from ascript.android import ...` works unchanged).
Coordinates are screen pixels in the current orientation.
Channel: accessibility or root, chosen by the run mode (auto / accessibility / root).
Device /eval runs in a separate :eval process that is killed on timeout; assign the answer to `_result`.

YOLO (v5/v8/v11 ONNX) and PaddleOCR (PP-OCRv6 tiny/small, v5, v4 ONNX) run on-device through ONNX Runtime: xscript.android.yolo / paddle, or screen.detect / screen.ocr(engine='paddle_v6t' | 'auto' | 'paddle'). AScript's YoLov5, plug.load('Yolov8Ncnn') and Ocr.paddleocr map onto them (ONNX files instead of NCNN).
云控: xscript.android.cloud (send / on_message / connect); AScript cloud_control and system.channel work. Launch parameters from 云控 app_run are system.params().
